incidents.title: Phishing Attack Detected

incidents.impact_details: 3 employees clicked links, credentials reset required

incidents.impact_details: PC isolated, forensic analysis in progress

incidents.root_cause: Access control panel power supply failure

incidents.impact_details: Attempt unsuccessful, awareness training reinforced

incidents.impact_details: Affected 50 remote users for 3 hours
